title: Patch: tabular numbers and balanced headlines across the menus
thread:
**Issue #2123 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2123: Patch: tabular numbers and balanced headlines across the menus
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts.

## What

**Tabular numbers.** The board and auth stylesheets set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, but these don't:
- `game/clock.css`, where the turn clock's digits pop in every second and shift width;
- `shop/shop.css`, `packs/packs.css`, `packs/pack-object.css`;
- `economy/economy.css`, `economy/xp.css`;
- `collection/collection.css`, `routes/leaderboard.css`, `routes/stats.css`.

Apply it to every number that changes in place or lines up in a column: counts, prices, wallets, XP and token bars, ladder ranks and ratings, and stats tables.

**Balanced headlines.** Today only `auth/tavern.css` (`balance`) and `routes/landing.css` (`pretty`) use `text-wrap`. Add one rule in `index.css`:
- `text-wrap: balance` on `h1`–`h3`, dialog titles, toast titles and the result screen's heading;
- `text-wrap: pretty` on prose paragraphs.

**Card faces are out of scope for both.** `cards/fit.ts` measures and fits their text, and a different wrap changes the fitted size.

## Done when

- A stylesheet test, in the style of `fx/css.test.ts`, checks that:
  - the listed number classes carry `tabular-nums`;
  - `index.css` carries the `text-wrap` rule;
  - no card-face selector gets `text-wrap` or a new `font-variant-numeric`.
- e2e spec `46` is green.
- Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`.

## Ground rules (from #2036)

- Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state.
- The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line.
```
